# Memory Eternal > 跨会话沉淀和审阅知识卡，并提供核心记忆与用量账本 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[EternalNight996/memory-eternal](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal) - **版本号**：0.21.0（[固定提交 e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/tree/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-05（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核查固定提交的让多个客户端复用同一批已审核项目知识。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：开发者在 DSH 与其他 MCP 客户端之间反复交代项目知识。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 本地知识库配合人工审核与用量观测。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 审核和本机存储均无法决定模型路由是否会接收对话与核心卡。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 审核后复用稳定项目约束可能减少重复输入，需计入审核及蒸馏开销。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 以隔离 vault 和虚构数据验证审核、检索和核心注入。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 本地知识库配合人工审核与用量观测。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 审核和本机存储均无法决定模型路由是否会接收对话与核心卡。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 审核后复用稳定项目约束可能减少重复输入，需计入审核及蒸馏开销。 将批准前、批准后与撤销状态分别验收。 ## 场景与替代办法 开发者在 DSH 与其他 MCP 客户端之间反复交代项目知识。 维护项目说明并在每次任务中显式加入。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH 或 MCP 宿主 | 按入口 | 访问记忆库 | 先固定一个客户端 | | 模型路由 | 蒸馏可选 | 可能处理正文 | 使用已核对路由 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 虚构知识和隔离库 | 记下配置 | | 运行 | 比较待审、批准和拒绝 | 记录调用和上下文 | | 复核 | 对比无插件基线 | 检查正确率及账单 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 部署和本机存储未知 | 设定路由与审核策略耗时未知 | 取决于宿主 | | 持续 | 模型与存储用量未知 | 审核、纠错与清理耗时未知 | 受频率及内容长度影响 | | 恢复 | 备份和回退未知 | 处理保留资料耗时未知 | 取决于数据管理要求 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 审核与可见性 | 逐阶段对照 | 只让预期卡进入复用 | | 净收益 | 比较用量与人工耗时 | 区分召回和蒸馏开销 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：让多个客户端复用同一批已审核项目知识 ### Q01 · 适合什么任务？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 对频繁跨会话和客户端切换的开发者，作者提出同一 SQLite vault、审核队列和记忆账本。相对手工维护说明，它能形成可查看的待审条目并复用已批准知识。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:15-23](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/README.md#L15-L23) 作者描述共享库、审核和账本 ```text > **Your AI forgets every session. Give it a memory it can trust.** > > Local-first, review-gated, measurable — one SQLite vault shared by DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client. - 🔍 **Review before it counts** — new cards wait in a review queue; approve or reject from the Web UI or terminal; every change is written to an immutable audit log. - 🧾 **Token ledger** — see how much recall injected, how many distillation calls ran, and how often recall was actually useful. - 🏠 **Local-first, no cloud** — SQLite + Markdown on your own disk. No third-party memory framework, no account. Memory data never leaves the machine; only the News page fetches public RSS / Hacker News on demand (titles, excerpts and outbound links only). - ⭐ **Core memory** — promote approved cards to always-on memory; every session gets them automatically, and the review queue still decides what qualifies. - 🧭 **Reader & layout** — clickable table of contents in the card reader, plus a compact / normal / large layout setting for the whole memory UI. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:27-47](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/README.md#L27-L47) 作者描述 DSH 与 MCP 入口
查看原文（21行） ````text ## ⚡ Quick start **DeepSeek Harness (desktop / web)** ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add memory-eternal # reopen DSH → sidebar "Memory" ``` **Claude Code, Codex or Cursor — same vault via MCP** ```bash npm i -g memory-eternal dsh-memory connect claude # or: codex / cursor ``` **Any MCP client** ```bash npx -y -p memory-eternal dsh-memory mcp ``` ````
#### 缺口 - 跨客户端实际兼容性须验证。 **影响**：有机会减少重复输入。 **进一步探讨**：选一个项目决策做小规模复用。 ### Q02 · 如何采集和注入？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 采集可走原文卡或经模型蒸馏；原文分支仍持久化正文并按审核配置设状态。核心记忆独立刷新并注册为系统提示段。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[index.js:752-769](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/index.js#L752-L769) 关闭蒸馏或缺少 LLM 时直接存原文卡
查看原文（18行） ```text // 成本控制：distillEnabled=false 时不调 LLM，直接存原文卡（零蒸馏成本） const source = DSH_AGENT if (cfg.distillEnabled === false || !llm) { const rawTitle = deriveTitle(text) const rawKind = guessRawKind({ title: rawTitle, body: text }) const out = await captureCard(root, { kind: rawKind, title: rawTitle.length >= 6 && !looksTruncated(rawTitle) ? rawTitle : '对话原文记录', tags: ['raw'], body: text, source, status: resolveAuditStatus(cfg, rawKind, source || 'unknown'), submittedBy: source || 'unknown', severity: 'info', reason: 'AI 自动沉淀（原文卡）', }, { threshold: cfg.dedupThreshold }) if (out.ok) { countWrite(); logCapture(sessionId, 'created', '原文卡（蒸馏已关闭）', { path: out.path ?? out.rel, kind: rawKind }) } else if (out.duplicate) { countWrite(); logCapture(sessionId, 'appended', '与已有卡重复 → 追加更新记录', { path: out.duplicate.path }) } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[index.js:1053-1076](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/index.js#L1053-L1076) 获取核心记忆并定期刷新系统提示段
查看原文（24行） ```text const refresh = async () => { try { const cfg = settings.get() ?? {} if (cfg.enabled === false || cfg.coreMemoryEnabled === false) { clearSection(); lastText = ''; return } const { coreMemoryPrompt } = await import('./lib/core-memory.js') const out = await coreMemoryPrompt(vaultDir(), { enabled: true, limit: cfg.coreMemoryLimit, maxChars: cfg.coreMemoryMaxChars, }) if (!alive) return if (!out.text) { clearSection(); lastText = ''; return } if (out.text === lastText) return lastText = out.text clearSection() disposeSection = ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'memory-eternal: core-memory', order: 120, text: out.text, }) } catch { /* 核心记忆失败不能影响普通对话 */ } } refresh() timer = setInterval(refresh, 5000) ```
#### 缺口 - 原文与蒸馏的存储内容和成本不同。 **影响**：核心记忆可能进入每次模型调用。 **进一步探讨**：标记一条无敏虚构核心卡并检查上下文。 ### Q03 · 本机数据库是否意味着资料留在本机？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 源码将对话正文及候选上下文交给配置的 LLM 路由蒸馏，并可能重试。核心记忆也进入系统提示。默认审核 all 可配置关闭，状态审核不能代替传输许可。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[index.js:139-143](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/index.js#L139-L143) 审核配置可选全审或免审 ```text // auditMode: 'all'=全部要审(默认) | 'none'=全部免审直接入库 // auditExemptAgents: 免审的智能体名列表（如 codex / claude-code / 本地 DSH） // auditExemptKinds: 免审的知识类型列表（如 tool / mistake） // 命中任一免审条件 → 新卡直接 approved 入库，否则进 pending 待审 auditMode: z.union([z.const('all'), z.const('none')]).default('all'), ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[index.js:820-852](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/index.js#L820-L852) 正文和邻近项交给选定模型路由，失败可能重试
查看原文（33行） ```text const attempt = (budget, ms) => { llmCalls++; return summarizeTurnDetailed(llm, route, text, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(ms), existing: neighbors, maxTokens: budget, sessionId }) } let detailed = await attempt(maxTokens, baseTimeout) if (detailed.failure && isTimeoutFailure(detailed.failure)) { const longer = Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(baseTimeout * 2.5), baseTimeout + 30000), 180000) logCapture(sessionId, 'listen', `蒸馏超时（${route.provider}/${route.model}）：可能是模型冷启动 → 以 ${Math.round(longer / 1000)}s 超时重试同一候选`) detailed = await attempt(maxTokens, longer) } // #18 建议 3 + #24：撞输出上限不是「模型坏了」，把上限一路翻倍到 schema 上限。 // 旧实现只翻倍**一次**：1200 → 2400 仍不够就照样退成原文卡，尽管 4000 本来装得下 // （issue #24 里 9 次失败中有一半正是被这一限制吃掉的）。 // #48：JSON 被截断（TRUNCATED_OUTPUT）与 MAX_TOKENS 同类处理 —— 靠加倍预算而不是换模型 const truncLike = (x) => Boolean(x && (x.code === 'MAX_TOKENS' || x.code === 'TRUNCATED_OUTPUT')) let prevBudget = maxTokens for (const bigger of maxTokenLadder(maxTokens)) { if (!truncLike(detailed.failure)) break logCapture(sessionId, 'listen', `输出撞到上限（${detailed.failure.code}，maxTokens=${prevBudget}）→ 以 ${bigger} 重试同一候选（${route.provider}/${route.model}）`) detailed = await attempt(bigger, baseTimeout) prevBudget = bigger } if (detailed.card !== undefined) { result = detailed.card; failure = null; break } if (detailed.failure) { const f = { ...detailed.failure, provider: route.provider, model: route.model } // 「模型回了散文」要记住：下次选路把它排到最后，别每轮都先白烧一次（issue #47） if (f.code === 'MODEL_NOT_JSON') { try { const st = await import('./lib/model-strikes.js'); st.recordModelStrike(process.env, route, f.code) } catch { /* 记不下来不影响主流程 */ } } failures.push(f) // 只保留第一个：旧实现每轮覆盖，最终上报的是**最后一个兜底候选**的错误， // 真正有信息量的主因被彻底丢弃（#18 根因 2）。 if (!failure) failure = f const more = i < routes.length - 1 logCapture(sessionId, 'fail', `蒸馏调用失败（${route.provider}/${route.model}）：${f.code} ${f.message}${more ? ' → 换下一个 provider 重试' : ''}`) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[index.js:1064-1072](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/index.js#L1064-L1072) 核心记忆写入系统提示 ```text if (!out.text) { clearSection(); lastText = ''; return } if (out.text === lastText) return lastText = out.text clearSection() disposeSection = ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'memory-eternal: core-memory', order: 120, text: out.text, }) ``` #### 缺口 - 远程模型路由会改变资料流向。 **影响**：本机落盘、模型处理与卡片审核要分开核对。 **进一步探讨**：测试前明确路由和配置。 ### Q04 · 部署与成本怎样界定？ **研究主题**：依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本、采用判断 #### 完整回答 作者给出 DSH 插件和 MCP 接入。账本记录字符和调用等指标，实际 token 与费用依模型和重试。先限制测试到隔离本机 vault。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:27-53](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/README.md#L27-L53) 作者提供 profile、MCP 与本机界面用法

**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:56-64](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/blob/e27ffe507986b470a828801b66bfe6a798cd760b/README.md#L56-L64) 作者列出账本观测指标 ```text ## 🧾 Does it actually save tokens? ## ⚡ Quick start **DeepSeek Harness (desktop / web)** ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add memory-eternal # reopen DSH → sidebar "Memory" ``` **Claude Code, Codex or Cursor — same vault via MCP** ```bash npm i -g memory-eternal dsh-memory connect claude # or: codex / cursor ``` **Any MCP client** ```bash npx -y -p memory-eternal dsh-memory mcp ``` **Browser or terminal** ```bash dsh-memory open # http://127.0.0.1:7999 npx -y -p memory-eternal dsh-memory tui # live queue in the terminal ``` ## 🧾 Does it actually save tokens? Most memory products say they save tokens. We think you should check. The plugin ships a built-in **memory ledger** (Runtime status → Memory ledger) that records: | Recorded | What it means | |---|---| | recall: hits + injected characters | how much memory actually entered the context | | capture: LLM calls + input/output characters | what distillation cost you | | usefulness: useful / not-useful feedback | whether recalled memories actually helped | The honest math: ```text net benefit ≈ avoided context cost − (injected characters + distillation calls × price) ``` | Scenario | You pay | You avoid | |---|---|---| | Multi-session project with decisions and pitfalls | ~0.6–0.9k tokens per recall | re-explaining context (~1.5–3k) or re-reading files (3–6k) | | One-off question, low hit rate | recall injection | usually nothing | > Illustrative numbers, not a benchmark — measure your own with the ledger. If recall usefulness stays below ~60%, tune it down (fewer results, shorter summaries) or turn memory off. ## 🛡️ Review first, prove later A memory system that silently ingests everything will eventually recall a wrong fact as truth. memory-eternal defaults to **review-before-commit**: - new cards land in a **pending queue**; nothing enters the main vault until a human approves it; - approve, reject or bulk-process from the Web UI, the terminal TUI, or the CLI; - every status change is appended to an **immutable audit log** (who / what / when / why) — enforced at the SQLite layer, not by convention; - agents can read and propose, but **cannot approve their own cards**; - deleted cards go to a recycle bin (30 days by default). ## ⭐ Core memory Not everything should be injected into every session. Core memory is the small, explicit set of rules and preferences that must always win: - any approved card can be promoted from the reader or card list; - auto-capture may **suggest** core only for explicit long-term preferences / hard constraints, and core candidates always stay pending for review; - approved core cards are injected into the system prompt of every session — no `memory_recall` call needed; - set a card limit and character budget in Settings → Memory → Core memory; - in the knowledge graph, core nodes are orange diamonds with a ★; - never store secrets or API keys in a core card; keep only a pointer to the credential directory. ## 🎛 Reader & layout - click any heading in the reader's table of contents to smoothly scroll to that section; - Settings → Memory → Layout size offers **compact / normal / large** for the whole UI; it only affects display. ## 🧩 One vault, every agent | Entry | What you get | |---|---| | **DSH desktop / web** | embedded memory UI: review, graph, config, ledger | | **Claude Code / Codex / Cursor** | MCP server, same local vault, dsh-memory connect | | **Any MCP client** | npx -y -p memory-eternal dsh-memory mcp | | **Terminal** | dsh-memory tui — live queue, select-all, batch approve/reject, long-form reader | | **Browser** | dsh-memory open → http://127.0.0.1:7999 | ## 📸 Screenshots
